note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-2 T-64A technical description and operation manual (Book 1, 1984). Section 1.2 publishes the combat weight, the overall length, the width, the height, the ground clearance, the maximum road speed, the fuel range, the climb gradient and the fording and underwater-driving depths. It publishes no engine rating, no track shoe width and no track pitch in the held pages, so the engine, its displacement and the power stay at grade claimed from the tier-5 article, and the two track fields stay absent. The manual covers the T-64A; the figures recorded name that variant.

operating_weight_kg.locator: 1.2 Основные тактико-технические параметры, Общие данные, Боевая масса row, printed page 7
operating_weight_kg.state: T-64A combat weight published as 38.5 t; the tonne taken as 1,000 kg

length_mm.locator: 1.2 Основные размеры, Длина с пушкой вперёд row, printed page 7
length_mm.state: overall length with the gun forward published as 9,225 mm; the gun rearward length is 9,605 mm

width_mm.locator: 1.2 Основные размеры, Ширина танка по съёмным щиткам row, printed page 7
width_mm.state: width over the removable skirts published as 3,415 mm; over the tracks 3,270 mm

height_mm.locator: 1.2 Основные размеры, Высота танка (по крыше башни) row, printed page 7
height_mm.state: height to the turret roof published as 2,170 mm

ground_clearance_mm.locator: 1.2 Основные размеры, Клиренс (по основному днищу) row, printed page 7
ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance at the main floor published as 500 mm

max_speed_kmh.locator: Эксплуатационные данные, Скорости движения, максимальная, по шоссе row, printed page 7
max_speed_kmh.state: maximum road speed published as 60.5 km/h; the average road speed is 45 to 50 km/h

range_km.locator: Эксплуатационные данные, Запас хода по топливу, без дополнительных бочек, по шоссе row, printed page 7
range_km.state: road range published as 500 to 600 km without the auxiliary fuel tanks; the top of the published range taken

max_gradient_deg.locator: Эксплуатационные данные, Максимальный угол подъёма row, printed page 7
max_gradient_deg.state: maximum climb gradient published as 30 degrees

fording_depth_mm.locator: Эксплуатационные данные, Глубина брода (без предварительной подготовки танка) row, printed page 7
fording_depth_mm.state: fording depth without preparation published as 1.8 m

wading_depth_mm.locator: Эксплуатационные данные, Водные преграды с использованием ОПВТ, глубина row, printed page 8
wading_depth_mm.state: depth with the underwater driving kit published as 5 m, at a current speed up to 1.5 m/s

engine_model.state: engine published as a 5TDF 5-cylinder diesel, 13.6 litre, as published; retained from the tier-5 article because the held manual pages do not state the engine

engine_displacement_l.state: engine published as 13.6 litre; retained from the tier-5 article because the held manual pages do not state the displacement

published_power_hp.state: engine power published as 700 hp (522 kW), with no net basis; retained from the tier-5 article because the held manual pages do not state the rating
